cards.ex: The company went belly up after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin kompaniya bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biznesning butunlay muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lib, yopilib ketishi.

cards.ex: He flunked out of college after his first year.
cards.exUz: U birinchi yilidan keyin kollejdan haydaldi.
cards.uzDef: O'qishda yaxshi o'qimaslik natijasida universitetdan haydalish.

cards.ex: Many startups fall by the wayside in their first year.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina startaplar birinchi yillarida cheklanib qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir sababga ko'ra maqsadga erisha olmaslik, tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: The project was a dismal failure from the start.
cards.exUz: Loyiha boshidan achinarli muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I didn't think we could do it, but we pulled it off.
cards.exUz: Biz buni qila olamiz deb o'ylamagan edim, lekin biz buni uddaladik.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vazifani muvaffaqiyatli bajarmoq.

cards.ex: We're finally making headway on the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Biz nihoyat muzokaralarda oldinga siljiyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Maqsad sari asta-sekin, lekin doimiy ravishda rivojlanish.

cards.ex: Once we got the funding, it was smooth sailing.
cards.exUz: Biz moliyalashtirishni olganimizdan so'ng, hammasi oson kechdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidek oson va muammosiz davom etadigan narsa.

cards.ex: The dot-com bubble caused many companies to crash and burn.
cards.exUz: Dot-kom pufagi ko'plab kompaniyalarning qulab tushishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash, ayniqsa boshlanganidan keyin.

cards.ex: It took us a year to get the project off the ground.
cards.exUz: Loyihani yo'lga qo'yish uchun bizga bir yil kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi loyihani boshlash va muvaffaqiyatli qilish.

cards.ex: She's a talented young lawyer who's going places.
cards.exUz: U iste'dodli yosh advokat, u muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new product was a runaway success.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulot katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilganidan ham katta va tez muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: We hit a snag in the negotiations, but we're working it out.
cards.exUz: Biz muzokaralarda to'siqqa duch keldik, lekin biz uni hal qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan qiyinchilik yoki muammo paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The plan was poorly conceived and doomed to fail.
cards.exUz: Reja yomon o'ylab topilgan va muvaffaqiyatsizlikka mahkum edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshidanoq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi aniq bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Another company bit the dust in the competitive market.
cards.exUz: Raqobatbardosh bozorda yana bir kompaniya mag'lub bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Mag'lubiyatga uchrash yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka duch kelish.

cards.ex: I struck out trying to get a promotion this year.
cards.exUz: Men bu yil lavozimga ko'tarilishga urinib, mag'lub bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Harakat muvaffaqiyatsizlik bilan yakunlanishi.

cards.ex: All their hard work finally bore fruit.
cards.exUz: Ularning barcha mashaqqatli mehnatlari nihoyat samara berdi.
cards.uzDef: Sarflangan harakat natija bermoq, muvaffaqiyat keltirmoq.

cards.ex: He won the championship and then rested on his laurels.
cards.exUz: U chempionatda g'alaba qozondi va keyin dam olib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi yutuqlar bilan kifoyalanib, yangi harakat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: You have to reach for the stars if you want to achieve greatness.
cards.exUz: Agar buyuklikka erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, yulduzlarga intilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta maqsadlarga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Having connections can help you get a leg up in the industry.
cards.exUz: Aloqalarga ega bo'lish sizga sanoatda afzallik olishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga nisbatan afzallikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: That job was a dead end, so I quit.
cards.exUz: Bu ish chiqish yo'li yo'q edi, shuning uchun men ishdan bo'shadim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday muvaffaqiyatga olib kelmaydigan vaziyat yoki harakat.

cards.ex: With a score like that, the game is pretty much in the bag.
cards.exUz: Bunday hisob bilan o'yin deyarli cho'ntakda.
cards.uzDef: Hali tugallanmagan bo'lsa ham, muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi kafolatlangan.

cards.ex: The stock market took a beating last week.
cards.exUz: O'tgan hafta fond bozori yomon ahvolga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy zarar ko'rmoq, katta muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq.

cards.ex: He made a killing in the real estate market.
cards.exUz: U ko'chmas mulk bozorida katta foyda ko'rdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson yo'l bilan katta miqdorda pul topmoq.

cards.ex: All that hard work just went down the drain.
cards.exUz: Barcha mashaqqatli mehnat behuda ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha harakatlar va resurslar behuda ketmoq.

cards.ex: Winning the award was a feather in his cap.
cards.exUz: Mukofotni qo'lga kiritish uning faxrli yutug'i edi.
cards.uzDef: Maqtanarli va e'tiborga loyiq bo'lgan yutuq.

cards.ex: The band was a flash in the pan, disappearing after one hit song.
cards.exUz: Guruh bir xit qo'shiqdan keyin g'oyib bo'lgan qisqa muddatli hodisa edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez boshlanib, tez tugaydigan muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: We came up short on the fundraising goal.
cards.exUz: Biz mablag' yig'ish maqsadiga erisha olmadik.
cards.uzDef: Kerakli darajaga yetmaslik, maqsadga erisha olmaslik.

cards.ex: With your talent, the sky's the limit.
cards.exUz: Sizning iste'dodingiz bilan chegara yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatlar yoki erishish mumkin bo'lgan narsalarga hech qanday cheklov yo'q.

cards.ex: Many businesses went bust during the recession.
cards.exUz: Inqiroz davrida ko'plab korxonalar bankrot bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Puli tugab, biznesi yopilishi.

cards.ex: I'm just not cut out for office work.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki ofis ishiga mos emasman.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir ish yoki vazifa uchun mos qobiliyatga ega bo'lmaslik.
